description: This file defines a utility class StringUtils with static methods for string manipulation, including case conversion, case-insensitive suffix and prefix checks, and method name extraction from qualified strings. It is a helper utility component used within the codebase.

classes.name: StringUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static string manipulation methods, including case conversion, case-insensitive suffix/prefix checks, and method name extraction.

methods.name: string toLower(const string & input)
methods.description: Converts an input string to lowercase.

methods.name: bool rfindInsensitive(const string & reference,const string & key)
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive rfind to check if the key exists as a suffix in the reference string.

methods.name: bool checkStartsWithCaseInsensitive(const string & method,const string & key)
methods.description: Checks if the reference string starts with the key in a case-insensitive manner.

methods.name: string extractMethodName(const string & method)
methods.description: Extracts the method name from a qualified string (e.g., after the last dot) and converts it to lowercase.

ctags.name: checkStartsWithCaseInsensitive
ctags.pattern: /^    static bool checkStartsWithCaseInsensitive(const string& method, const string& key) {$/

ctags.name: rfindInsensitive
ctags.pattern: /^    static bool rfindInsensitive(const string& reference, const string& key) {$/
